__faion_header__.purpose: Skeleton of the portfolio EVM rollup artefact: one data date and currency, per-project EVM rows, stale projects apart, currency-sum aggregate with LOE separate, weighting, thresholds, money block, owner sign-off.
__faion_header__.consumes: per-project week-grain PV / EV / AC ledger exports, the portfolio variance and weighting policies, the executive review date (AGENTS.md `## Prerequisites`)
__faion_header__.produces: a rollup matching the JSON Schema in content/02-output-contract.xml; validate with scripts/validate-portfolio-evm-rollup-method.py --file
__faion_header__.depends-on: content/02-output-contract.xml for the schema; content/04-procedure.xml for the order of filling
__faion_header__.token-budget-impact: ~300 tokens per project row plus ~250 for the aggregate and summary; ~200 to validate
